<!--
THE TWO CONTROLS (added 2026-09-17; see README.md "The two controls")
  TC = TREATMENT CONTROL: the day-3 animals held under ambient conditions in the same
  system and for the same time as the stressor arms. Every contrast in this script compares
  a stressor's day-3 animals with them, so the coefficient is the stressor effect net of time
  in the system, handling and byssal secretion state. These are the DEG lists of record.
  LC = LAB CONTROL: the day-0 animals; contrasts against them (02_5_DESeq_*_LC_genome.Rmd)
  carry the time-in-system component as well and are context, not stressor effects.
-->

### Load and clean up treatment info and gene count matrix 
```{r}
# Load in treatment info and GCM files
treatmentinfo <- read_csv(file.path(dat, "treatmentinfo_clean.csv"))
gene_count_matrix_clean_og <- read_delim(file.path(dat, "gene_count_matrix_clean.csv"), delim = ",")

# Make transcripts the row names
rownames <- gene_count_matrix_clean$...1
gene_count_matrix_clean <- subset(gene_count_matrix_clean, select = -c(...1))
rownames(gene_count_matrix_clean) <- rownames
gene_count_matrix_clean <- data.matrix(gene_count_matrix_clean)
```

### All treatments
```{r}
# Filter for gill tissue and treatment control
G_TC_treatmentinfo <- treatmentinfo %>% filter(tissue == "G") %>%
  filter(!(day == "0")) 
write.table(G_TC_treatmentinfo, file = file.path(deg, "Gill/G_TC_treatmentinfo.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# Subset count matrix
G_TC_countmatrix <- subset(gene_count_matrix_clean, select=(G_TC_treatmentinfo$sample.1))
G_TC_countmatrix <- data.frame(G_TC_countmatrix)
write.table(G_TC_countmatrix, file = file.path(deg, "Gill/G_TC_countmatrix.csv"))

# Run DESeq
# Explicit factor levels. The originals passed the grouping variable as character and let
# R's locale collation pick the reference level; in a C locale "DO", "OA" and "OW" sort
# before "control", coefficient 2 becomes control_vs_<trt>, and every log2 fold change
# flips sign silently. The stopifnot() after DESeq() guards the coefficient name.
G_TC_treatmentinfo$treatment <- factor(G_TC_treatmentinfo$treatment, levels = c("control", "OA", "OW", "DO"))

dds27 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = G_TC_countmatrix,
                              colData = G_TC_treatmentinfo,
                              design = ~ treatment)

dds27 <- DESeq(dds27)
resultsNames(dds27) # lists the coefficients
stopifnot(resultsNames(dds27)[2] == "treatment_OA_vs_control",
          all(c("treatment_OW_vs_control", "treatment_DO_vs_control") %in% resultsNames(dds27)))

# Graph dds results
PCAdata <- plotPCA(vst(dds27), intgroup = c("treatment"), returnData=TRUE)
percentVar <- round(100*attr(PCAdata, "percentVar")) #plot PCA of samples with all data
ggplot(PCAdata, aes(PC1, PC2, color=treatment)) + 
  geom_point(size=4, alpha = 5/10, shape = "triangle") +
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ",percentVar[1],"% variance")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ",percentVar[2],"% variance")) + 
  coord_fixed()+
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.95)+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_manual(labels = c("Treatment control", "Ocean acidification", "Ocean warming", "Hypoxia"), values = c("purple", "red", "orange", "green"))   # label order = factor levels (control, OA, OW, DO)+
  guides(color=guide_legend("Treatment"))+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size =18, color = "black"))+
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size =20, color = "black"))+
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size =18, color = "black"))+
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size =20, color = "black"))+
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)

```


### OA vs treatment control
```{r}
# Load gill ocean acidification treatment info, compared with treatment control
GOA_TC_treatmentinfo <- read_delim(file.path(deg, "Gill/GOA_TC_treatmentinfo.csv"), delim = " ")

# subset count matrix
GOA_TC_countmatrix <- subset(gene_count_matrix_clean, select=(GOA_TC_treatmentinfo$sample.1))
GOA_TC_countmatrix <- data.frame(GOA_TC_countmatrix)
write.table(GOA_TC_countmatrix, file = file.path(deg, "Gill/GOA_TC_countmatrix.csv"))

# CaTCulate DESeq object
# Explicit factor levels. The originals passed the grouping variable as character and let
# R's locale collation pick the reference level; in a C locale "DO", "OA" and "OW" sort
# before "control", coefficient 2 becomes control_vs_<trt>, and every log2 fold change
# flips sign silently. The stopifnot() after DESeq() guards the coefficient name.
GOA_TC_treatmentinfo$treatment <- factor(GOA_TC_treatmentinfo$treatment, levels = c("control", "OA"))

dds12 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = GOA_TC_countmatrix,
                              colData = GOA_TC_treatmentinfo,
                              design = ~ treatment)

dds12 <- DESeq(dds12)
resultsNames(dds12) # lists the coefficients
stopifnot(resultsNames(dds12)[2] == "treatment_OA_vs_control")   # guards the sign of every log2FC

# graph dds
PCAdata <- plotPCA(vst(dds12), intgroup = c("treatment"), returnData=TRUE)
percentVar <- round(100*attr(PCAdata, "percentVar")) #plot PCA of samples with all data
ggplot(PCAdata, aes(PC1, PC2, color=treatment)) + 
  geom_point(size=4, alpha = 5/10) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ",percentVar[1],"% variance")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ",percentVar[2],"% variance")) + 
  coord_fixed()+
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.95)+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_manual(labels = c("Treatment control", "Ocean acidification"), values = c("lavender", "pink"))+
  guides(color=guide_legend("Treatment"))

# Filtering: keep genes that have at least 10 counts across 1/3 of the samples - https://support.bioconductor.org/p/110307/
keep <- rowSums(DESeq2::counts(dds12) >= 10) >= ncol(GOA_TC_countmatrix)/3
dds12_filt <- dds12[keep,]

```
